title: The Parking Lot...
content: The dream started in a store within the mall. It was kind of small but was filled with a lot of people. It seemed to be a comic book store that also sold candies. The entire back wall was covered in works of art. Mostly of superheroes and villains, horror movie characters and such. I wanted to buy a couple but they were very expensive. At some point I left the store and then entered a grocery store. I kept eating and drinking things off the shelfs. I ended up calling my aunt and she told me she wanted her car back. I told her I would go and get it so I walked outside into the parking lot. I don't remember anything of how I even got outside, but I did. I was outside the entrance of a movie theater and what looked like a series of bars and clubs. There were a ton of people hanging out outside. Some guy showed up and he seemed to be a friend. He offered to help find my aunt's car. I remember searching the entire parking lot of the theater but found nothing. The guy then said he would drive me around the entire mall to look for the car. I remember we were speeding around a mostly empty parking lot. There were a few cars here and there. We almost ran over some people and hit a few of the only cars that were around. Somehow we ended up in the parking lot of a nearby strip mall. The place seemed dead. It even looked that some of the vacant stores were being used like apartments by some people. For some reason I kept thinking that the car might now be in front of this strip mall. So the guy drove me there. Once again, no car. At this point I figured the car had to be stolen. But we drove around again, almost running over people in front of the theater. I decided I was going to call my grandfather to come and pick me up. In reality, he passed away over a decade ago. But he said he would come to pick me up in front of the strip mall. We drive there to meet up with him and for some reason he's riding on an old tractor. We ended up getting on the tractor with him. he took us to a small grocery store that was in the strip mall. I'm not sure why we got there. But there was a man working behind the register and he had a son that seem to have down syndrome. I dont remember buying anything but then I was sure that I did park the car over by the theater. My grandfather drove us over to the theater and I started to run around the parking lot, which was now full of cars. I ran up and down and then realized I had the fob on my. I pressed the button and the cars lights blinked and on and off, plus it made that sound. I finally got in the car and decided to drive off. I drove all around the mall, almost running into people again. although I noticed I seemed to be driving on a track that was made up of the various buildings that ran all around the main mall. the way out of this track was in front of where the strip mall was. it led straight out into an empty highway. This is where I drove off too. I wanted to drive home but I ended up waking up. The two things I hate about these dreams are the classrooms and the parking lots.
